mcpProtocolVersions.comment: Which MCP revisions this endpoint actually serves. `served` is the honest list — a revision only appears there once a probe has observed the endpoint answering it. `planned` is a revision the code is being written for and is NOT a claim of support. Kept truthful by three things: scripts/registry-check.mjs validates the shape, mcp/audit/protocol.mjs re-derives it from the live endpoint on every audit run (audit-report.json -> protocol), and tests/mcp-dual-era-client.test.mjs fails if `served` disagrees with the server this repo actually boots.

legacy.notes: The initialize handshake negotiates the revision and the server returns an Mcp-Session-Id. Clients on 2025-11-25 and earlier use this path.

modern.notes: Stateless. Every request carries io.modelcontextprotocol/protocolVersion (required) and io.modelcontextprotocol/clientCapabilities (required) in params._meta, plus the matching MCP-Protocol-Version header. Served beside the legacy handshake, not instead of it: server/discover answers, and a legacy initialize exchange is unchanged.
